name: A fall on ice
prompt: Your feet go out from under you on a patch of black ice. Your wrist took the fall.

outcome.told: You flex your hand on the way home.
outcome.line: {you} fell on the ice and walked it off.

failure.told: By night the wrist is swollen and you can't close your hand.
failure.line: {you} fell on the ice and hurt a wrist.

choices.text: Get it seen at urgent care

outcome.told: An X-ray shows a sprain. They wrap it and send you home.
outcome.line: {you} fell on the ice and had a wrist seen at urgent care.
